description: This file contains helper functions and interfaces for managing API group versions, resource encoding configurations, and runtime API group/version filtering within the Kubernetes API server. It includes functions for merging configurations, parsing group/version strings, and enabling/disabling API resources based on runtime flags.

classes.name: GroupVersionRegistry
classes.description: Interface providing access to registered API group versions, including registration checks and retrieval of prioritized versions.

methods.name: MergeResourceEncodingConfigs
methods.description: Merges default resource encoding configuration with specific GroupVersionResource overrides.

methods.name: MergeAPIResourceConfigs
methods.description: Merges default API resource configuration with overrides, considering registry registration status.

methods.name: ParseGroups
methods.description: Extracts group names from resource configuration.

methods.name: ParseGroupVersions
methods.description: Extracts group versions from resource configuration.

methods.name: EmulationForwardCompatibleResourceConfig
methods.description: Creates a resource configuration that enables all higher priority versions of enabled resources, excluding alpha versions, for forward compatibility.
